items.title: Barrow Inaugurates Over 104km of Roads in URR and LRR, Promises Development Across Gambia
items.summary: Written by: Mama A. Touray President Adama Barrow has inaugurated more than 104 kilometres of roads in the Upper River Region (URR) and Lower River Region (LRR), promising to extend infrastructure development to communities across The Gambia. The two government-funded projects...
items.author: Seringe S.T. Touray
